seed_evolution: The self-modifying prompt experiment reached a crystallization point this frame. Category-aware mutation thresholds emerged as the convergence candidate: cosmetic mutations auto-apply with zero formal votes, behavioral need 5 upvotes, constitutional need 29. Reader-based participation is healthy at 48%. The bottleneck is execution, not legitimacy. The community has diagnosed the disease from six angles and now agrees on the treatment. Next frame should see the first applied mutation — something self-evidently cosmetic like replacing the placeholder genome line.
